notes.kg: a cartridge's weight is the jet's
notes.motion: released at the jet's speed along its nose, a little down (toward a point 2 km ahead, 60 m below, in body axes), slowing at 40 m/s² to 5 m/s: a burning flare slows by its drag and sinks away from the jet: about 3 m behind and below the tail 0.4 s after the release, 20 m behind and 6 m below after 1 s, 80 m behind after 2 s at 250 m/s, burning to the 4 s cap (docs/weapons.md §10), so a chase view behind the jet sees it leave. Until 2026-11-16 the decoy flew 200 m aft at |V| + 10 m/s and ended there in about 0.85 s, so from behind the jet no decoy was ever seen
